welcome.text: Morning, {called}. On time today. I'm almost disappointed.
Welcome to the skills lab. Six stations. And everything you break in here is plastic.
Scrubbing, monitors, histories, instruments: those four before theatre tomorrow. IV lines and stitches too, if you're keen. Theatre usually wants all of them at once.
Pick a station. Mistakes are free today. Tomorrow, they aren't.
welcome.head: nod

scrub_intro.text: Theatre rule one. Nothing dirty touches the patient. That includes you.
Water, soap, every bit of both hands, properly. Then rinse, towel, gown, gloves. In that order.
And once you've soaped up, don't touch your face. Not your mask, not your nose. I'm watching.
scrub_intro.head: nod

monitor_intro.text: This screen talks to you the whole operation. Most people stop listening. And then it starts screaming.
Learn the four numbers first. Then I'll show you some patients, and you tell me what's wrong before it's too late.
monitor_intro.head: nod

history_intro.text: Half of surgery is asking the right question before the knife comes out.
I'll be the patient. Mr. Kumar. You get five questions. Find what could hurt him on the table.

instruments_intro.text: Tom D'Souza. Scrub nurse. I hand you things, you don't drop them. That's basically our whole relationship.
First, match each job to the right instrument. Then Dr. Iyer calls for things, and you tell me. Fast.

iv_intro.text: An IV line. You'll do about a hundred of these before you ever do an operation.
Pick a good vein, get the angle right, and keep your hand still. The arm's plastic. Pretend it isn't.
iv_intro.head: nod

stitch_intro.text: Every operation ends the same way. Somebody has to close.
Stitches across the cut, end to end, nice and even. Patients judge you by the scar, not the surgery.

again.text: Again? Good. Habits are built, not born.

done.text: That's the four that matter. I've seen worse. I've also seen better... but I'm in a good mood.
Tomorrow you assist me in theatre. An appendix. A student called Rohit, nineteen. Read his notes tonight.

then.text: Everyone's ready until the first cut. We'll see.
then.head: nod

then.text: Good. Nervous people wash their hands properly.
